en: To prepare a plan or idea carefully; or to express an idea clearly in words.
ex: The team formulated a plan to increase sales.
團隊擬定了一個提高銷售的計畫。

en: To make something easier to do or understand.
ex: The new software will simplify the booking process.
新軟體將簡化預訂流程。

en: To make something lighter in weight, color or mood; or to make a load or problem less heavy.
ex: She told a joke to lighten the mood.
她講了個笑話來緩和氣氛。

en: The act of making secret information known; or the information revealed.
ex: The disclosure of the secret documents shocked the nation.
機密文件的曝光震驚了全國。

en: A scientist who studies stars, planets and other objects in space.
ex: The astronomer discovered a new planet last year.
那位天文學家去年發現了一顆新行星。

en: Friendly and enthusiastic; or large and satisfying, as a meal.
ex: After the long hike, we enjoyed a hearty breakfast.
健行結束後，我們享用了一頓豐盛的早餐。

en: The central part of an atom or cell; or the main part around which something grows.
ex: The nucleus of an atom contains protons and neutrons.
原子核包含質子和中子。

en: To cut something with a sweeping movement; or to greatly reduce prices or costs.
ex: The company slashed prices by half during the sale.
公司在特賣期間把價格砍到一半。

en: The likely future of something; or a person's general attitude toward life.
ex: The economic outlook for next year looks uncertain.
明年的經濟前景看起來不明朗。

en: A small reptile with a long tail and four short legs that can run fast.
ex: A lizard ran across the rock and disappeared.
一隻蜥蜴爬過岩石消失了。

en: A sauce added to salad; or the act of putting on clothes; or a cover for a wound.
ex: Would you like oil or vinegar dressing on your salad?
你的沙拉要加油醋醬嗎？

en: Support and agreement among people who share the same aims or interests.
ex: Workers showed solidarity by joining the strike.
工人們以加入罷工來表示團結。

en: A stick that fits under the arm to help someone walk; or something you rely on too much.
ex: After the accident, he had to walk on crutches for weeks.
事故之後，他必須拄拐杖走路好幾週。

en: Following the exact meaning of the words, without any imagination or exaggeration.
ex: Don't take what he said literally; he was joking.
別按字面意思理解他的話，他是在開玩笑。

en: A large, comfortable house, often in the country or by the sea, used for holidays.
ex: They rented a villa near the sea for the summer.
他們夏天在海邊租了一棟別墅。

en: Good for your health or good for your moral well-being.
ex: The restaurant serves simple, wholesome food.
這家餐廳供應簡單而健康的食物。

en: The distance from one side of something to the other; or the wide range of something.
ex: The room is five meters in breadth.
這間房間寬五公尺。

en: Having an important effect on the final result; or able to make decisions quickly.
ex: The goal in the last minute was decisive.
最後一分鐘的進球具有決定性。

en: The quality of dealing with ideas rather than real things; or an idea that is not connected to reality.
ex: Math often involves a high degree of abstraction.
數學常涉及高度的抽象。

en: Unable to see things clearly when they are far away; or lacking the ability to plan ahead.
ex: She is nearsighted and needs glasses to see the board.
她近視，要戴眼鏡才看得到黑板。

en: To begin or to have a particular source or cause.
ex: The custom originated in ancient Greece.
這項習俗起源於古希臘。

en: According to the usual way of doing things in a particular society or situation.
ex: It is customary to bring a gift when you visit someone.
拜訪別人時，帶份禮物是慣例。

en: Having no pity or mercy; cruel and determined to get what you want.
ex: He was a ruthless businessman who cared only about profit.
他是個只在乎利潤的無情商人。

en: A name, symbol or design that is legally registered and used by a company for its products.
ex: The company registered the name as a trademark.
公司把這個名稱註冊為商標。

en: The movement of something in a circle around a central point; or a system of taking turns.
ex: The Earth's rotation causes day and night.
地球的自轉造成了白晝與黑夜。

en: Giving a lot of information in few words; short and clear.
ex: Please write a concise summary of the report.
請寫一份報告的簡明摘要。

en: The time of day when the sun has just gone down and it is not yet completely dark.
ex: We reached the village just as dusk was falling.
我們到達村子時正好天色漸暗。

en: Your family and relatives.
ex: The police informed the next of kin of the accident.
警方通知了死者近親這起事故。

en: To make someone feel ashamed or lose their dignity in front of others.
ex: The teacher humiliated the student in front of the class.
老師當著全班的面羞辱了那個學生。

en: Belonging to each of the people or things mentioned separately.
ex: The two leaders returned to their respective countries.
兩位領導人返回各自的國家。

en: Comfortable and warm in a pleasant, small place.
ex: We spent a cozy evening by the fire.
我們在爐火旁度過了溫馨的夜晚。

en: To kill someone by squeezing their throat so they cannot breathe; or to prevent something from growing.
ex: Heavy regulation threatens to strangle small businesses.
繁重的管制有可能扼殺小企業。

en: A vegetable with long, pale green stems that you can eat raw or cooked.
ex: She chopped some celery and carrots for the soup.
她切了一些芹菜和胡蘿蔔來煮湯。

en: A safety device that melts and cuts off electricity if the current is too strong; or to join together.
ex: The lights went out when a fuse blew.
保險絲燒斷時，燈全滅了。

en: Causing great damage, failure or harm.
ex: The decision to expand too quickly proved disastrous.
事實證明，過快擴張的決定帶來了災難。

en: To make an edge or point sharper; or to improve a skill or make something clearer.
ex: He sharpened the knife before cutting the meat.
他在切肉前先把刀磨利。

en: Done in a careless or untidy way; or wet and muddy.
ex: His sloppy handwriting is hard to read.
他潦草的字跡很難辨認。

en: A small, thin piece of something; or to come off in small, thin pieces.
ex: Paint was flaking off the old wall.
舊牆上的油漆正在剝落。

en: The loss of a job because a worker is no longer needed; or the fact of being more than necessary.
ex: Hundreds of workers faced redundancy when the factory closed.
工廠關閉時，數百名工人面臨被資遣。

en: Happy and cheerful.
ex: Santa Claus is known as a jolly old man.
聖誕老人以快樂的老爺爺聞名。
